description: Risk that AuroraPay e-Transfer experiences a widespread outage or severe degradation during core hours, preventing participants and end users from sending and receiving payments.
risk_appetite_statement: No more than 1 major AuroraPay e-Transfer outage per quarter; unplanned downtime ≤ 60 minutes per quarter.

description: Risk that recurring short-duration incidents (e.g., intermittent latency, partial failures) create a pattern of instability that erodes participant and customer trust even when SLAs are technically met.
risk_appetite_statement: No more than 4 minor incidents per month causing customer or participant-visible disruption.

description: Risk that fraudsters exploit social-engineering scams (e.g., fake invoices, impersonation) to induce customers to authorize AuroraPay transfers they did not intend, resulting in financial loss and reputational damage.
risk_appetite_statement: Fraud loss should not exceed 5 basis points (0.05%) of total AuroraPay e-Transfer volume on a rolling 12-month basis.

description: Risk that compromised credentials, devices, or access tokens allow unauthorized parties to send payments via AuroraPay channels without timely detection, leading to losses and customer harm.
risk_appetite_statement: Zero tolerance for systemic control failures; account takeover loss ≤ 2 basis points (0.02%) of volume and trending downward.

risk_name: Excessive privileged access to core AuroraPay systems
description: Risk that too many users or service accounts retain privileged access to core AuroraPay components, increasing the likelihood of misuse, configuration errors, or undetected security incidents.
risk_appetite_statement: No unresolved critical findings on privileged access; all privileged access reviewed at least quarterly.

risk_name: Insufficient security monitoring of payments infrastructure
description: Risk that gaps in logging, monitoring, or alerting prevent timely detection and investigation of anomalous activity or security incidents impacting AuroraPay.
risk_appetite_statement: Critical systems must have centralized logging and high-severity security alerts with defined SLAs for triage and response.

risk_name: Critical vendor outage impacting transaction processing
description: Risk that a critical external service provider (e.g., fraud analytics, connectivity, hosting) experiences an outage or major incident that disrupts AuroraPay transaction processing or fraud controls.
risk_appetite_statement: No more than 2 high-impact critical vendor outages per year; contracted RTO/RPO must be met in ≥ 95% of incidents.

description: Risk that control gaps at critical vendors (e.g., access, change management, security monitoring) undermine AuroraPay's overall control environment, leading to increased exposure to fraud, outages, or data breaches.
risk_appetite_statement: Zero tolerance for unremediated critical vendor control deficiencies beyond agreed target dates.

risk_name: Failure to meet incident and change notification expectations
description: Risk that AuroraPay does not consistently or promptly notify oversight bodies of material incidents or changes, leading to findings, loss of confidence, or mandated remediation.
risk_appetite_statement: Zero tolerance for confirmed breaches of material notification obligations.

risk_name: Inability to demonstrate alignment to risk appetite
description: Risk that risk decisions, control assessments, and remediation actions are not sufficiently documented to evidence alignment with risk appetite and standards during regulatory reviews or audits.
risk_appetite_statement: All material product risk decisions must be documented with clear rationale and linkage to risk appetite.

risk_name: Incomplete or ineffective privileged access reviews
description: Risk that periodic reviews of privileged access for AuroraPay systems are incomplete, insufficiently challenged, or not performed on schedule, allowing inappropriate or stale access to persist across environments.
risk_appetite_statement: 100% of in-scope privileged roles must be reviewed at least quarterly with documented challenge; no critical overdue recertifications.

risk_name: Inadequate remediation of recurring incident root causes
description: Risk that AuroraPay repeatedly experiences similar incidents (e.g., capacity, configuration, or vendor-related issues) because underlying root causes are not fully understood or remediated, leading to a pattern of instability and avoidable outages.
risk_appetite_statement: All high-severity incidents must have documented root cause and remediation actions; no more than 1 repeat major incident with the same primary cause in a 12-month period.
